notes: SR114 Made.com NL redirects to https://www.nextdirect.com/nl/nl/brands/madecom (brand:madecom facet inside Next's general Homeware department, 139 products total; same platform/situation as SR48 Made.com UK). 'Opruiming' is the standard Dutch retail term for clearance/liquidation sale (distinct from 'aanbieding'/'korting' generic-offer wording), matching the brief's own listed Clearance target term. This is reinforced by the site-wide config key "saleName":"Opruimingprijs" (clearance-price label) found in the page's global text/labels JSON, i.e. the platform treats 'sale' pricing as a permanent clearance-price mechanism it names 'Opruiming', not a temporary seasonal campaign. Verified by requesting the filtered URL https://www.nextdirect.com/nl/nl/brands/madecom/f/feat-sale directly: totalResults=2, and independently counted 2 unique product itemNumbers on the rendered page (exhaustion match, n=2 small enough for a single page load). No separate 'Sale'/promotional-campaign page was found competing with this (no Black Friday/seasonal-sale page under the madecom brand facet). Judgment: included as Clearance with no ambiguity flag because the site's own facet display label is literally the Dutch clearance term, not a generic sale word, and the count is independently verified. Breadcrumb on the filtered URL only shows 'madecom' (same as the prior pass's category-filter URLs for this same brand page, e.g. /f/category-dinnerware) - this is a facet-filtered view of the brand catalogue rather than a dedicated top-level landing page, consistent with how this brand's whole catalogue is structured (no separate nav-level pages exist for this brand at all, only facet filters).
